overloadPatches.semanticRole: Duplicates a list box column by programming (Application mode only, source form unmodified), addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Duplicates a list box column by programming (Application mode only, source form unmodified), addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
